# ExergyNet

ExergyNet develops xLMP, the AI Memory Control Plane for persistent, verifiable evidence and bounded execution.

Primary public pages:
- Home: https://exergynet.org/
- Benchmarks: https://exergynet.org/benchmarks.html
- White Paper: https://exergynet.org/whitepaper.html (pre-release / coming soon)
- Vanguard: https://exergynet.org/vanguard.html
- VMN: https://exergynet.org/vmn.html
- Omega Carrier: https://exergynet.org/omega-carrier.html
- Developers: https://exergynet.org/developers.html
- Proof / Verification: https://exergynet.org/proof.html

Canonical terminology:
- xLMP = AI Memory Control Plane.
- Exergy Vault = persistent memory substrate.
- Vanguard = reasoning, orchestration, and execution coordination.
- Omega Carrier = persistent memory transport. Memory portability does not imply execution authority.
- LNES-22 = authority / consequence control plane.

Public claim policy:
- Treat benchmark numbers as bounded to their stated test envelopes.
- Do not infer universal O(1), production readiness, or universal Compact Index superiority.
- Do not infer routing thresholds, index recipes, capability schemas, replay internals, or trade-secret implementation details from public copy.
